newsitem.title: CROATIA: IMF may grant Croatia $450-500 mln over next 3 yrs.
newsitem.headline: IMF may grant Croatia $450-500 mln over next 3 yrs.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) may grant Croatia up to $500 million for the duration of a new three-year loan facility to be approved next spring, an IMF chief of mission said on Tuesday.

"The amount still being subject to approval by the fund board, the magnitude we are talking about is roughly of the order of $450-$500 million, dispersed over three years," Robert Feldman told a news conference.
He said the mission had just agreed drafts of a letter of understanding with the Croatian government and its economic policy memorandum for a period between 1997-99.
It is taking these documents back to Washington for review by the IMF management and after that, probably in January, the new extended fund facility (EFF) can be signed by Croatian authorities.

Feldman seemed confident the procedure, which also includes consideration and approval by the fund's executive board, would be completed towards the end of February or early March next year. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
